scenarios.title: Sequence gap
scenarios.description: Skip a sequence number in the stream.
scenarios.detail: seq 101 missing (expected 100): GAP_DETECTED, halted=1, later events refused=1, book unchanged

scenarios.title: Duplicate event
scenarios.description: Re-deliver an event id that was already applied.
scenarios.detail: replayed event id 50: duplicate, applied-once=200/200, checksum identical

scenarios.title: Out-of-order event
scenarios.description: Deliver a later sequence before the one it follows.
scenarios.detail: seq 61 buffered, seq 60 filled the gap and drained 1 event(s); final book identical to in-order run

scenarios.title: Consumer slowdown
scenarios.description: Throttle the SPSC consumer against a bounded queue.
scenarios.detail: retry policy: 3495 retries, 4000/4000 delivered, 0 lost; drop policy: 3812 counted drops; book identical

scenarios.title: Snapshot recovery
scenarios.description: Restore a serialized book image and resume the stream.
scenarios.detail: image of 171 orders at seq 2000 (6912 bytes) restored: checksum verified, resumed 2000 events, state identical to uninterrupted run

scenarios.title: Invalid order
scenarios.description: Submit malformed orders and cancel/modify unknown ids.
scenarios.detail: 7/7 invalid events rejected, book unchanged, next valid order accepted=1
